name: GitHubScene
description: Synthetic GitHub repository and pull request surface. Supports modern slot HTML and a legacy PR-diff contract for quick incident/review scenes.

variant.description: Primary GitHub surface. Legacy PR props default to pr-diff.

repoBranchHtml.description: Branch label or HTML slot shown in the repository chrome.

branch.description: Legacy shorthand used when repoBranchHtml is omitted.

prTitle.description: Legacy PR title. Triggers PR-diff body generation when bodyHtml is omitted.

prNumber.description: Legacy PR number rendered beside prTitle.

stepsHtml.description: Legacy animated PR body HTML. Use .gh-step elements with data-kind/data-duration for sequenced reveals.

bodyHtml.description: Full main body HTML slot. Overrides legacy PR body generation.

repoTabsHtml.description: Repository tab strip HTML. Defaults to Code/Issues/Pull requests/Actions/Security.

qualityNotes: Prefer visible PR, issue, review, or repository artifacts over decorative code-like panels.
Use stepsHtml only for small legacy sequences; use bodyHtml for precise custom layouts.
Keep demo data fictional and use Contoso-style names/repos unless the user supplied public source material.
